name: Multiple Scattering Model (Integral Equation)
aliases: General integral equation for radiation transport
Radiative Transfer and Integral Equation Solvers
definition: A model accounting for multiple scattering events. It requires finding intensity I(X, ω) at each point X in each direction ω.
summary: The Multiple Scattering Model (Integral Equation) is a deterministic method solving the Radiative Transfer Equation by explicitly accounting for multiple scattering events, providing the exact integral formulation that other methods approximate.
